svg.title: Outbound operations: one event, delivered per destination at its pinned version
svg.desc: Provider emits an event once; for each destination it projects or downgrades to the pinned version, skips events that do not exist there, encodes and signs; the receiver verifies, decodes an open union and dispatches.
svg.text: Outbound operations: one event, delivered per destination at its pinned version
